title: How Much Do Solar Panels Cost in North Carolina for Homeowners
excerpt: Discover the current cost of solar panels in North Carolina and how to save with federal and state incentives.
content:
Cost of Solar Panels in North Carolina

The cost of solar panels in North Carolina ranges from $2.50 to $3.50 per watt, with an average solar panel system costing $15,000 to $25,000.

Factors Affecting Solar Panel Costs

Several factors influence the cost of solar panels in North Carolina, including system size, quality of panels, and installation company reputation.

State and Federal Incentives

North Carolina homeowners can save up to $5,000 with the federal solar tax credit and an average of $500 with state incentives.

Conclusion

While solar panel costs in North Carolina may seem high, the long-term savings and environmental benefits make solar energy a worthwhile investment. Visit SolarAtlas to find solar data for your city and start your solar journey today.
